idea-plugin.name: BuildMeter
idea-plugin.description: Records how long it takes from pressing Run or Debug on a .NET project until the app is ready (Now listening on: for web, worker and Blazor apps; process start for console apps). Records are written to ~/.buildmeter/events.jsonl and shown by the BuildMeter macOS menu bar app, the Windows tray app and buildmeter report. Build times themselves are recorded by the BuildMeter MSBuild hook.
